text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, you'd like me to perform on
stage?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm organizing an opera show, you see,
for the
upcoming children's fan event.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And I would like you to play the
supporting role
of the princess.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The princess? How lovely. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any experience in theater,
though. Is
that all right?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My eyes do not deceive me. You exude
elegance
with your delicate
temperament. To a child, you
would
appear the quintessential princess.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, with me as the script writer,
director, and
leading actor, the opera's
overwhelming success
is all but
guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Aah, what a fortunate and blessed being
you are
to have been chosen by the
Overlord to make
your operatic debut as
a heroine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...And that's what she said when she
invited me
for the role. I was thinking of
taking up the
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Why not? It's a good idea. Having more

experience on stage would benefit you
in your
winning concerts too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll come watch. I can help you rehearse
your lines
if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Would you really? I could tackle
anything with
you at my side, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to practice hard so I can bring
smiles to
all the children. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I walk past the outdoor stage
and see
some kind of show being held
for families who
live around the
neighborhood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Grandmother! Never would I have
believed
you were a witch. ♪

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
Pesky princess! A curse on you I shall
cast! ♪
Sleep now, and slumber
forevermore! ♪

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text: Take this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh dearie me. My body feels so weak,
and I'm
so... very... sleepy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Goood... niiight... Zzzz... Zzzz... ♪

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Princess, wake up!
The witch is so mean!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Aah! I have come too late. ♪ Princess!
What has
befallen you?! I will not let this
act go
unpunished! ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I recall the day when we both met! 'Twas
when I
had just gained awareness of the
world 'round
me. ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Since I was a child, I've always been a
beautiful,
handsome prince! And I stole
the eyes of every
lady in the palace. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Opera O's lines are so long. But the kids
seem
really into it, so I guess that's
good.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Bright's doing fantastic up there too.
She doesn't
seem nervous at all. She
might be a natural at
this.)

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And now, I will smite the evil witch and
bring
peace back to the world! ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Young friends! In order to awaken the
princess, I
require your help! Lend me
your voices! All at
once now! Let us wake
the princess!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Princeeeess... Wake uuup...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(The kids seem a little shy. I guess it
does take a
lot of courage to yell out
loud all of a sudden...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Not that it matters. Bright should open
her eyes
soon, and then the story will
end happily ever...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Um... Wait a minute. This wasn't in the
script.
What's Bright doing?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Is she actually asleep?! You have got to be kidding... This is bad!)

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Proud friends! Tiny heroes! Is that all the
power
you've got?! Come now! Show the
princess what
you're truly made of!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Princess! Please! You have to wake up!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's the spirit! The fate of the
princess
depends on the power of your
voices!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
We have to try harder! Princeeesss!
Waaake uuup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by T.M. Opera O, more
children
begin to join in and start
yelling, until...

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: PRINCEEEESS!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn. That was a nice nap.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay! The princess woke up!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Young heroes! The power within
each and
every one of you has awoken
the princess from
her deep slumber!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: We did it! We did it! Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The children smile and cheer together,
feeling a
deep sense of unity thanks to
the show, and the
opera finishes on a
high note.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you actually fell asleep on
stage... I
was so scared the show would
be ruined.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I accidentally stayed up too late

reviewing the script yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, Bright... Only you could still make
it work
out somehow.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What a brilliant performance that was!
What a
marvelous eye I have for talent,
to have found
such a diamond in the
rough!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My! ♪ It's really an honor to receive so
much
praise.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I particularly loved how you improvised
toward
the end and ignored the
children's cries in order
to draw them
further into the performance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You breathed life into the stage,
resulting in an
outstanding finale!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! Bright, you must be a part
of the
next work I perform at my family's
residence!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Are you offering me another
role? If you'll
have me, I would love to
come. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O continues to shower
Mejiro Bright
in praise, unaware that her
artistic choice was
nothing more than a
timely blunder.
